data.name: Ui.QuickGuideToScanningAndAIReports
data.value: Quick guide to scanning and AI reports

data.name: Ui.TheMenuClosesAfterSelectionAndThe
data.value: The menu closes after selection and the countdown appears on Scan Now.

data.name: Ui.PressScanNowRunningProcessesAreAnalyzed
data.value: Press Scan Now. Running processes are analyzed locally. Select a process to inspect its path, SHA-256 and publisher.

data.name: Ui.Choose151020OrCustom
data.value: Choose 1, 5, 10, 20 or custom minutes. The app collects evidence for the full interval. Use 10–20 minutes for miners and intermittent spyware behavior.

data.name: Ui.StableLowValueProcessesAreFilteredWhen
data.value: Stable low-value processes are filtered when the timer ends. A high score is an investigation priority, not proof of malware.

data.name: Ui.ClickCopyPromptTheButtonTurnsGreen
data.value: Click Copy Prompt. The button turns green and confirms the copy. Paste it into Codex or another AI.

data.name: Ui.IfTheAIRequestsEvidenceAttachThe
data.value: If the AI requests evidence, attach the referenced analysis-*.json file. Verify path, publisher and SHA-256 before deleting files or stopping processes.

data.name: Ui.SustainedOrSuddenlyRisingCPUHeavyWork
data.value: • Sustained or suddenly rising CPU • Heavy work without a visible window • New files in writable locations • Signature + network combinations • PID respawning and unusual traffic

data.name: Ui.ChronologicalTelemetryJsonlCorrelatedAnalysisJsonHuman
data.value: • Chronological telemetry.jsonl • Correlated analysis-*.json • Human-readable local summary • Clipboard-ready AI prompt • Investigation candidates with path + SHA-256

data.name: Ui.014Clean1529Low30
data.value: • 0–14 Clean • 15–29 Low • 30–54 Medium • 55–79 High • 80–100 Critical • CPU ≥ 35% and ≥ 70% are separate thresholds • Combined findings—not one signal—set the score

data.name: Ui.SamplesCorrelateByNamePathSHA256
data.value: • Samples correlate by name + path + SHA-256 • Average, peak and CPU range are calculated • Peak RAM and first/last seen are retained • PID count and respawning are tracked • Example: 5% → sustained 90% behavior is detected

data.name: Ui.SustainedHighCPUNoVisibleWindowWritable
data.value: • Sustained high CPU + no visible window • Writable location + unverified publisher • 20 seconds before Task Manager are analyzed • Compared with 15 seconds after launch • A ≥30% load dropping to 5% / one fifth is flagged

data.name: Ui.CounterDeltasAreCalculatedPerPIDUpload
data.value: • Counter deltas are calculated per PID • Upload ≥ 256 KB: meaningful change • Upload ≥ 10 MB: strong signal • Download ≥ 25 MB: attention signal • Remote IP/port and process role are interpreted together

data.name: Ui.NoiseIsRemovedWhenPeakCPU15
data.value: • Noise is removed when peak CPU <15% and change <12 • Network, new-file, signature and PID signals remain • Candidates are ranked by local risk score • Only meaningful time points are included • AI must report evidence, uncertainty and false positives

data.name: Ui.PIDProcessNameAndStartTimeCPU
data.value: • PID, process name and start time • CPU and physical RAM usage • Executable metadata and SHA-256 • Windows Authenticode / macOS codesign • Unavailable signals never increase risk

data.name: Ui.WindowsETWBytesIPHelperLinuxProc
data.value: • Windows: ETW bytes + IP Helper • Linux: /proc socket-to-PID mapping • macOS: active TCP endpoints via lsof • Remote IPs and ports are linked to processes • Missing telemetry is never treated as zero traffic

data.name: Ui.151020OrCustomMinutes
data.value: • 1, 5, 10, 20 or custom minutes • New sample about every 4 seconds • Live countdown • Previous data is excluded • Only the exact capture window is reported

data.name: Ui.RemovesStableLowLoadNoiseKeepsCPU
data.value: • Removes stable low-load noise • Keeps CPU spikes • Keeps network, new-file and signature signals • Preserves PID changes • Sends only meaningful candidates to AI

data.name: Ui.AllEvidenceStaysUnderProcWitnessDataNothing
data.value: • All evidence stays under ProcWitness/data • Nothing is uploaded automatically • Above 256 MB, the latest 7 days are retained • No deletion, quarantine or process termination • Final decision: hash + publisher + antivirus/EDR
